global.sectionTip: Controls the monitoring subsystem — collection cadence, master switch and retention.
global.enabledTip: When off, metrics collection, public probes and alert evaluation are all paused.
global.intervalTip: How often Manager pulls metrics from each node's Agent. Range 30–3600s. Takes effect within ~60s.
global.retentionDaysTip: How long node metrics, probe and alert history are kept before the collector purges them.

agents.sectionTip: Toggle which nodes to monitor and configure each node's Erocraft Agent endpoint and token. Disabled nodes are skipped.
agents.endpointTip: HTTP endpoint of the Erocraft Agent, usually the node FQDN on port 48765.
agents.tokenTip: Must match the token configured in the node's /etc/erocraft-agent/config.yaml. Leave blank to keep current.

email.sectionTip: Send email to selected admins when an alert fires or resolves. SMTP settings live in the SMTP tab.
email.enabledTip: Alerts are still recorded in the dashboard when disabled, just no email is sent.
email.recipientsTip: Select admin accounts to receive alert emails. Email is sent to the associated address.
email.notifyResolveTip: When enabled, a resolve email is sent for alerts that had previously been notified.
email.minSeverityTip: Only send emails for alerts at or above this severity.

types.sectionTip: Toggle email notification per alert type. Alerts are still recorded in the dashboard when the toggle is off; only email is suppressed. For thresholded alerts, adjust the threshold on the right.

thresholds.sectionTip: Thresholds are in percent or multiples. Sustain means the metric must exceed the threshold for that duration.
thresholds.cpuThresholdTip: Fire when node CPU usage exceeds this value. 80–95 is typical.
thresholds.cpuSustainTip: CPU must stay above threshold during this window (≥80% of samples).
thresholds.memThresholdTip: Fire when node memory usage exceeds this value.
thresholds.memSustainTip: Memory must stay above threshold during this window.
thresholds.swapThresholdTip: Fire when swap usage exceeds this value. Disabled by default, enable as needed.
thresholds.diskWarningTip: Raises a Warning alert when disk usage reaches this value.
thresholds.diskCriticalTip: Raises a Critical alert. Should be above the Warning threshold.
thresholds.loadFactorTip: Fire when 1-min load exceeds cpu_cores × factor. 1.5 means a 4-core node alerts at 6.0.
thresholds.loadSustainTip: Load must stay above threshold during this window.
thresholds.alertCooldownTip: An alert (node + type) won't re-email within this window; dashboard records remain unaffected.
